in_marathi.name: Arjunkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of Arjuna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjunkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjuna's Victorious Son Arjun is a legendary warrior from the Mahabharata. Arjunkumar means 'Son of Arjuna'. This name is a tribute to the brave and noble qualities of Arjuna, passed down to his son.
